item.title: EplayerX 1.2.11
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 改善设置页在玻璃背景上的文字与输入框可读性，统一字幕、弹幕和 MoviePilot 等设置项的输入样式。 - 修复弹幕回收后可能残留在画面上的问题，改善异步绘制稳定性。 - 改善旧版 SMB 服务器的文件复制兼容性及连接异常处理。 - 改善播放项目重建时 Dolby Atmos 音频输出的连续性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Improved text and input readability over glass backgrounds in Settings, with consistent input styling for subtitles, danmaku, MoviePilot, and more. - Fixed danmaku remaining onscreen after being recycled and improved asynchronous rendering stability. - Improved file-copy compatibility with older SMB servers and handling of connection failures. - Improved Dolby Atmos output continuity when playback items are rebuilt.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
